```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(readxl)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tnet)

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
input_dir <- if (length(input_file) == 1L && nzchar(input_file)) {
  dirname(input_file)
} else {
  getwd()
}
project_file <- "NMA network structure analysis.Rproj"
report_dir <- if (file.exists(file.path(input_dir, project_file))) {
  input_dir
} else if (file.exists(file.path(input_dir, "..", project_file))) {
  normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else {
  stop("Open NMA network structure analysis.Rproj before running this report.")
}
empirical_data_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Empirical data", "raw")
result_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Empirical data", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Reconstruct incidence matrices using the shared data-processing functions.
source(file.path(report_dir, "Common R functions", "data_processing.R"))
source(file.path(report_dir, "Common R functions", "metric_functions.R"))

database_colour <- "#0072B2"
y_axis_floor <- 0.5
x_label_unipartite_degree <- "Number of other treatments \n compared to each treatment"
x_label_bipartite_trial_degree <- "Number of arms in the trial"
x_label_bipartite_treatment_degree <- "Number of trials including the treatment"
plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
theme_set(plot_theme)

plain_log_labels <- function(x) {
  format(x, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}
plain_log_breaks <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]
  10^seq(0, ceiling(log10(max(x))))
}
```

# Read the empirical database

No previously saved metric table is read in this report. Every empirical
network is reconstructed from its raw Excel workbook.

```{r read-raw-database}
empirical_files <- list.files(
  empirical_data_dir,
  pattern = "^570-[0-9]+_dataset\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
empirical_files <- empirical_files[order(
  as.integer(sub(
    "^570-([0-9]+)_dataset\\.xlsx$", "\\1",
    basename(empirical_files), ignore.case = TRUE
  ))
)]
if (length(empirical_files) == 0L) stop("No empirical Excel datasets found.")

empirical_networks <- list()
empirical_raw_data <- list()
failed_empirical_files <- character()
for (file_i in empirical_files) {
  network_id <- sub("_dataset\\.xlsx$", "", basename(file_i), ignore.case = TRUE)
  raw_data <- tryCatch(
    suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(file_i)),
    error = function(error) error
  )
  if (inherits(raw_data, "error")) {
    failed_empirical_files <- c(failed_empirical_files, network_id)
    next
  }
  empirical_raw_data[[network_id]] <- raw_data

  B <- tryCatch(
    create_edge_list(raw_data),
    error = function(error) error
  )
  if (inherits(B, "error") || is.null(B) || nrow(B) == 0L || ncol(B) == 0L) {
    failed_empirical_files <- c(failed_empirical_files, network_id)
    next
  }
  empirical_networks[[network_id]] <- B
}
if (length(empirical_networks) == 0L) stop("No empirical networks were valid.")

saveRDS(
  empirical_networks,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_incidence_networks.rds")
)
writeLines(
  failed_empirical_files,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_files_not_processed.txt")
)
cat("Raw workbooks processed:", length(empirical_networks), "\n")
cat("Raw workbooks not processed:", length(failed_empirical_files), "\n")
```

# Extract and validate arm sample sizes

Each row of the sample-size file identifies one trial-treatment arm. Long-format
workbooks contribute `n` for `(StudyID, t)`, while wide-format workbooks match
`n1`, `n2`, ... to `t1`, `t2`, ... by their numeric suffix. The error log has
one row per network and error category.

```{r extract-empirical-sample-sizes}
empty_sample_size_data <- function() {
  data.frame(
    network_id = character(), StudyID = character(),
    t = character(), n = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

empty_sample_size_log <- function() {
  data.frame(
    network_id = character(), reason = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

is_missing_database_value <- function(x) {
  x_character <- trimws(as.character(x))
  is.na(x) | x_character == "" |
    tolower(x_character) %in% c("na", "n/a", "null", ".", "-", "—", "–")
}

extract_sample_sizes <- function(raw_data, network_id) {
  columns_raw <- names(raw_data)
  columns_normalized <- norm_col(columns_raw)

  study_index <- which(
    columns_normalized == "studyid" |
      grepl("^studyid\\d*$", columns_normalized) |
      grepl("^id\\d*$", columns_normalized)
  )
  long_t_index <- which(columns_normalized == "t")
  wide_t_index <- which(grepl("^t\\d+$", columns_normalized))

  errors <- empty_sample_size_log()
  if (length(study_index) == 0L ||
      (length(long_t_index) == 0L && length(wide_t_index) == 0L)) {
    errors <- data.frame(network_id = network_id, reason = "Column not found")
    return(list(data = empty_sample_size_data(), errors = errors))
  }

  study_column <- columns_raw[study_index[1]]
  arm_rows <- list()

  if (length(long_t_index) > 0L) {
    n_index <- which(columns_normalized == "n")
    n_column_found <- length(n_index) > 0L
    if (!n_column_found) {
      errors <- bind_rows(
        errors,
        data.frame(network_id = network_id, reason = "Column not found")
      )
    }
    arm_rows[[1]] <- data.frame(
      StudyID = as.character(raw_data[[study_column]]),
      t = as.character(raw_data[[columns_raw[long_t_index[1]]]]),
      n_raw = if (n_column_found) {
        as.character(raw_data[[columns_raw[n_index[1]]]])
      } else {
        rep(NA_character_, nrow(raw_data))
      },
      n_column_found = n_column_found,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    for (t_index in wide_t_index) {
      suffix <- sub("^t", "", columns_normalized[t_index])
      n_index <- which(columns_normalized == paste0("n", suffix))
      n_column_found <- length(n_index) > 0L
      if (!n_column_found) {
        errors <- bind_rows(
          errors,
          data.frame(network_id = network_id, reason = "Column not found")
        )
      }
      arm_rows[[length(arm_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        StudyID = as.character(raw_data[[study_column]]),
        t = as.character(raw_data[[columns_raw[t_index]]]),
        n_raw = if (n_column_found) {
          as.character(raw_data[[columns_raw[n_index[1]]]])
        } else {
          rep(NA_character_, nrow(raw_data))
        },
        n_column_found = n_column_found,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  arms <- bind_rows(arm_rows)
  valid_pair <- !is_missing_database_value(arms$StudyID) &
    !is_missing_database_value(arms$t)
  arms <- arms[valid_pair, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(arms) == 0L) {
    return(list(data = empty_sample_size_data(), errors = distinct(errors)))
  }

  n_missing <- is_missing_database_value(arms$n_raw)
  n_numeric <- to_numeric_tolerant(arms$n_raw)
  n_integer <- !n_missing & is.finite(n_numeric) &
    abs(n_numeric - round(n_numeric)) < 1e-8

  # A missing n column is already represented by "Column not found". Only
  # present n columns are checked for missing cell values.
  if (any(arms$n_column_found & n_missing)) {
    errors <- bind_rows(
      errors,
      data.frame(
        network_id = network_id,
        reason = "Missing data for (StudyID, t)"
      )
    )
  }
  if (any(arms$n_column_found & !n_missing & !n_integer)) {
    errors <- bind_rows(
      errors,
      data.frame(network_id = network_id, reason = "n is not integer")
    )
  }

  n_numeric[n_integer] <- round(n_numeric[n_integer])
  sample_size_data <- data.frame(
    network_id = network_id,
    StudyID = trimws(arms$StudyID),
    t = trimws(arms$t),
    n = n_numeric,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(data = sample_size_data, errors = distinct(errors))
}

sample_size_results <- lapply(names(empirical_raw_data), function(network_id) {
  extract_sample_sizes(empirical_raw_data[[network_id]], network_id)
})

empirical_sample_sizes <- bind_rows(
  lapply(sample_size_results, `[[`, "data")
)
empirical_sample_size_errors <- bind_rows(
  lapply(sample_size_results, `[[`, "errors")
) |>
  distinct(network_id, reason) |>
  arrange(network_id, reason)

write.csv(
  empirical_sample_sizes,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_sample_sizes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
write.csv(
  empirical_sample_size_errors,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_sample_size_errors.log"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Trial-treatment sample sizes extracted:", nrow(empirical_sample_sizes), "\n")
cat("Networks with sample-size errors:",
    n_distinct(empirical_sample_size_errors$network_id), "\n")
```

# Compute and save empirical results

```{r compute-empirical-results}
# This table includes the mean bipartite trial/treatment degrees and the mean
# weighted/unweighted unipartite degrees returned by metric_functions.R.
empirical_metrics <- compute_metrics_for_networks(empirical_networks)
mean_degree_columns <- c(
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree",
  "mean_unipartite_weighted_degree",
  "mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree"
)
stopifnot(all(mean_degree_columns %in% names(empirical_metrics)))
degree_irregularity_columns <- c(
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg"
)
stopifnot(all(degree_irregularity_columns %in% names(empirical_metrics)))
stopifnot("diameter" %in% names(empirical_metrics))

weighted_degree_variance <- vapply(empirical_networks, function(B) {
  B <- 1L * (as.matrix(B) != 0)
  B <- B[rowSums(B) >= 2L, , drop = FALSE]
  B <- B[, colSums(B) > 0L, drop = FALSE]
  weighted_projection <- crossprod(B)
  diag(weighted_projection) <- 0
  stats::var(rowSums(weighted_projection))
}, numeric(1))

empirical_weighted_degree_summary <- empirical_metrics |>
  transmute(
    network_id,
    N = N_treatments,
    mean_weighted_degree = mean_unipartite_weighted_degree,
    variance_weighted_degree = unname(
      weighted_degree_variance[network_id]
    )
  )
empirical_edge_multiplicity <- compute_edge_multiplicity_for_networks(
  empirical_networks
)
empirical_MNS <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(empirical_networks), function(i) {
  B <- empirical_networks[[i]]
  data.frame(
    network_id = names(empirical_networks)[i],
    M = nrow(B), N = ncol(B), S = sum(B)
  )
}))

degree_rows <- lapply(seq_along(empirical_networks), function(i) {
  B <- empirical_networks[[i]]
  projection <- crossprod(B)
  diag(projection) <- 0
  graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
    1L * (projection > 0), mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE
  )
  list(
    unipartite = data.frame(
      network_id = names(empirical_networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(degree(graph))
    ),
    trial = data.frame(
      network_id = names(empirical_networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(rowSums(B))
    ),
    treatment = data.frame(
      network_id = names(empirical_networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(colSums(B))
    )
  )
})
empirical_degree_unipartite <- bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "unipartite"))
empirical_degree_trial <- bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "trial"))
empirical_degree_treatment <- bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "treatment"))

aggregate_degrees <- function(data) {
  data |> filter(degree > 0) |> count(degree, name = "count")
}
empirical_degree_counts <- list(
  unipartite = aggregate_degrees(empirical_degree_unipartite),
  trial = aggregate_degrees(empirical_degree_trial),
  treatment = aggregate_degrees(empirical_degree_treatment)
)

saveRDS(empirical_metrics, file.path(result_dir, "empirical_metrics.rds"))
saveRDS(
  empirical_edge_multiplicity,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_edge_multiplicity.rds")
)
saveRDS(empirical_MNS, file.path(result_dir, "empirical_MNS.rds"))
saveRDS(
  list(
    unipartite = empirical_degree_unipartite,
    trial = empirical_degree_trial,
    treatment = empirical_degree_treatment,
    counts = empirical_degree_counts
  ),
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_degrees.rds")
)
write.csv(empirical_metrics, file.path(result_dir, "empirical_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  empirical_edge_multiplicity,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_edge_multiplicity.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(empirical_MNS, file.path(result_dir, "empirical_MNS.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(empirical_degree_counts$unipartite, file.path(result_dir, "degree_unipartite.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(empirical_degree_counts$trial, file.path(result_dir, "degree_bipartite_trial.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(empirical_degree_counts$treatment, file.path(result_dir, "degree_bipartite_treatment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Basic characteristics

## Numbers of trials and treatments

```{r empirical-MN-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
p_num_trial <- ggplot(empirical_MNS, aes(x = M)) +
  geom_histogram(
    fill = database_colour, colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
    binwidth = 10, boundary = 0
  ) +
  labs(title = "(a)", x = "Number of trials", y = "Number of networks")

p_num_treat <- ggplot(empirical_MNS, aes(x = N)) +
  geom_histogram(
    fill = database_colour, colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
    binwidth = 2, boundary = 4
  ) +
  labs(title = "(b)", x = "Number of treatments", y = "Number of networks")

p_MN_scatter <- ggplot(empirical_MNS, aes(x = N, y = M)) +
  geom_count(
    aes(size = after_stat(n)), shape = 21,
    fill = database_colour, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 8, limits = c(1, 6), breaks = 1:6, name = "Count",
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  labs(title = "(c)", x = "Number of treatments", y = "Number of trials")

p_empirical_MN <- p_num_trial + p_num_treat + p_MN_scatter +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
p_empirical_MN

```

# Degree distributions

The three panels correspond to the **Final output figures** section of
`soft_config_model.Rmd`.

```{r prepare-degree-fits}
trial_counts <- empirical_degree_counts$trial |> filter(degree >= 2)
trial_vector <- rep(trial_counts$degree, trial_counts$count)
trial_k_min <- min(trial_vector)
trial_p <- 1 / (mean(trial_vector - trial_k_min) + 1)
trial_theta <- 1 - trial_p
trial_geometric_line <- data.frame(
  degree = seq.int(trial_k_min, max(trial_vector))
) |>
  mutate(count = length(trial_vector) * trial_p * trial_theta^(degree - trial_k_min))

empirical_trial_geometric_fit <- list(
  theta = trial_theta,
  k_min = trial_k_min,
  n = length(trial_vector),
  line = trial_geometric_line
)
saveRDS(
  empirical_trial_geometric_fit,
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_trial_geometric_fit.rds")
)
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    theta = trial_theta,
    k_min = trial_k_min,
    n = length(trial_vector)
  ),
  file.path(result_dir, "empirical_trial_geometric_fit.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r empirical-final-degree-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
    title = "(c)", x = x_label_bipartite_treatment_degree,
    y = "Number of treatments"
  ) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9))

p_empirical_all_degree <- p_degree_uni + p_degree_trial + p_degree_treatment +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1)
p_empirical_all_degree

```

# Check for repeated networks

The `network_id` column is excluded when comparing rows. All remaining metric
values must match exactly for a pair to be reported.

```{r check-repeated-networks}
metric_columns <- setdiff(names(empirical_metrics), "network_id")

if (nrow(empirical_metrics) < 2L) {
  repeated_network_pairs <- data.frame(
    network_id_1 = character(),
    network_id_2 = character()
  )
} else {
  candidate_pairs <- utils::combn(seq_len(nrow(empirical_metrics)), 2L)
  same_metrics <- apply(candidate_pairs, 2L, function(pair) {
    all(vapply(metric_columns, function(column) {
      identical(
        empirical_metrics[[column]][pair[1]],
        empirical_metrics[[column]][pair[2]]
      )
    }, logical(1)))
  })
  repeated_pairs <- candidate_pairs[, same_metrics, drop = FALSE]
  repeated_network_pairs <- data.frame(
    network_id_1 = empirical_metrics$network_id[repeated_pairs[1, ]],
    network_id_2 = empirical_metrics$network_id[repeated_pairs[2, ]]
  )
}

if (nrow(repeated_network_pairs) == 0L) {
  cat("No repeated networks found in empirical_metrics.\n")
} else {
  cat("Network ID pairs with exactly matching metrics:\n")
  print(repeated_network_pairs, row.names = FALSE)
}
```
Checked:
- 6, 32, 75 are different network extractions.
- 10, 193 are different network extractions.
- 255, 266 are different network extractions.
